newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma sees opportunities in Southeast Asia.
newsitem.headline: Rauma sees opportunities in Southeast Asia.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Tuesday it saw good demand for its products in Southeast Asian markets.
"A clear shift in the focus of demand, to the markets of Southeast Asia, is projected for pulp and paper industry investments," Rauma said in a statement with its 1996 results.

"Infrastructure development in Southeast Asia is projected to remain strong, bolstering good demand for rock crushing equipment," it said. "Investments are expected to remain at a good level in the mining industry and the petrochemical and chemical industries."
